cases.case_label: AluYb8 c.4475_4476ins in exon 14 of BRCA1
cases.disease: Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome
cases.mechanism_detail: An AluYb8 (319 nt plus 32-A tail) inserted in BRCA1 exon 14 causes complete skipping of exon 14 in patient RNA, producing a frameshift and premature stop (p.Ala1453Glyfs*10).
cases.quote: The c.4475_c.4476insAluYb8 mutation impacts splicing and induces the skipping of exon 14.
